purpose: Respond to a proposed situation with relevant advice or judgment.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
Plain clause + なら; noun / な-adjective + なら.
If you are going to Kyoto, I recommend this shop.
If tomorrow is impossible, let us do it next week.
If we are going by car, let us check parking first.
Choose a conditional that fits the situation
formation: Plain clause + なら; noun / な-adjective + なら.
restrictions: Often treats the condition as a topic or premise already raised.
mistake: The action in the main clause can occur before the conditional event.
